static_findings.snippet: 1. **Always lint after changes** - Run `markdownlint --fix` then `markdownlint` to verify
2. **Run from repository root** - Ensures `.markdownlint.json` config is loaded
The project uses markdownlint with these specific rules (from `.markdownlint.json`):
- **MD003**: Heading style must be ATX (`# Heading` not `Heading\n===`)
- Use ATX style (`#`) not underline style
Use the `process_order()` method to handle orders.
The `$order_id` parameter must be an integer.
- Most markdown issues are auto-fixable with `markdownlint --fix`

content.value_statement: WooCommerce docs need consistent Markdown structure and lint compliance. This skill guides formatting, examples, links, tables, and markdownlint checks.
actual_capabilities: Applies WooCommerce markdownlint rules for headings, lists, code blocks, and file endings.
Formats headings, lists, tables, links, emphasis, and directory trees.
Provides a lint and auto-fix workflow using markdownlint commands.
Explains common markdownlint errors with corrected examples.
Gives special guidance for CLAUDE.md, README, and changelog files.
limitations: Does not install markdownlint or project dependencies.
Does not replace human review of documentation accuracy.
Covers WooCommerce repository standards, not every Markdown style guide.
Command examples require a local WooCommerce checkout and appropriate tooling.

use_cases.title: Standardize Developer Documentation
use_cases.description: Apply WooCommerce Markdown rules to README files, setup guides, and feature documentation.

use_cases.title: Clean Up Lint Failures
use_cases.description: Identify Markdown structure issues and apply fixes that match repository lint rules.

use_cases.title: Prepare AI Assistant Docs
use_cases.description: Create clear CLAUDE.md files with hierarchy, tables, links, and code block languages.

prompt_templates.title: Format a Markdown File
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this WooCommerce Markdown file for headings, lists, code blocks, and links. Apply the project style and summarize key changes.

prompt_templates.title: Fix Lint Errors
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the WooCommerce Markdown rules to fix these lint errors. Preserve the meaning and explain any issue that needs manual review.

prompt_templates.title: Create a README Section
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a README section for this WooCommerce feature. Include clear headings, lists, links, and language labels for code blocks.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Complex Documentation
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this long WooCommerce document for Markdown structure, lint compliance, directory trees, tables, and AI-readable organization.

output_examples.input: A README section has skipped heading levels and mixed list markers.
output_examples.output: A revised section with sequential headings, hyphen bullets, blank lines around lists, and a short note about remaining content questions.

output_examples.input: A changelog draft has bold labels, missing code block languages, and inconsistent spacing.
output_examples.output: A cleaned changelog entry with proper headings, labeled code blocks, consistent list spacing, and markdownlint-ready structure.

output_examples.input: A CLAUDE.md file needs clearer organization for an AI assistant.
output_examples.output: A structured assistant guide with a table of contents, clear sections, concise bullets, and repository-specific Markdown conventions.

best_practices: Run markdownlint from the repository root after editing documentation.
Use explicit language labels on every fenced code block.
Keep README, changelog, and CLAUDE.md files structured for scanning.
anti_patterns: Skipping lint checks after Markdown changes.
Using bold text as a substitute for headings.
Adding absolute paths where repository-relative links are expected.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps write and revise WooCommerce Markdown files using repository formatting and lint rules.

faq.question: Does it run markdownlint automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides the workflow and command guidance, but tool execution depends on the AI environment.

faq.question: Can it fix README files?
faq.answer: Yes. It can structure README content with headings, lists, links, and code block languages.

faq.question: Can it review CLAUDE.md files?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for AI assistant documentation that should remain clear and lint compliant.

faq.question: Does it validate technical accuracy?
faq.answer: No. It improves Markdown structure, but subject matter accuracy still needs human review.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
